title.zh: Coinbase gives community banks a stablecoin bridge while supplying infrastructure underneath
title.en: Coinbase gives community banks a stablecoin bridge while supplying infrastructure underneath

current_state.zh: Coinbase is partnering with payments platform Moov to let community banks and credit unions offer stablecoin custody and payment services through their existing banking relationships, while Coinbase supplies the underlying infrastructure.
